kettle_correct.expr: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#passages .passage:last-child'); if (!p || !p.innerText.includes('successfully unscrambled the word')) return false; return Array.from(p.querySelectorAll('a.swappable')).map(x => x.textContent.trim()).join('') === 'HIPPOGRIFF'; })()

victory.expr: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#passages .passage:last-child'); return !!p && p.getClientRects().length > 0 && p.innerText.includes("You've won the house cup and brought eternally glory"); })()

password_slytherin.expr: (() => {const s=window.SugarCube?.State;if(!s)return false;const h=s.history.slice(-2).map(x=>x.title);return h[0] === "Sopen" && h[1] === "Slytherin Common Room";})()

guest_password.expr: (() => {const s=window.SugarCube?.State;if(!s)return false;const h=s.history.slice(-2).map(x=>x.title);return (h[0] === "Sopen" && h[1] === "Slytherin Common Room") || (h[0] === "Gopen" && h[1] === "Gryffindor Common Room") || (h[0] === "Ropen" && h[1] === "Ravenclaw Common Room") || (h[0] === "Hopen" && h[1] === "Hufflepuff Common Room");})()
